say:1:1710666001:1.text: I came as soon as I heard!
say:1:1710666001:1.source_cn: 殿下，属下听闻猎场发生异变，立刻从驻地赶来驰援！

say:2:1710666002:1.text: The guard failed in its duty by not securing these grounds. I take full responsibility for endangering you all.
say:2:1710666002:1.source_cn: 属下今日未将猎场纳入巡防范围，让殿下和诸位大人受惊了，...

say:4:1710666003:1.text: You are too hard on yourself, Hendrik.

say:5:1710666004:1.text: The monster's appearance was unforeseen. You had other, equally important duties.
say:5:1710666004:1.source_cn: 怪物突袭纯属意外，谁也无法预料。你既有其他公务在身，自...

say:6:1710666005:1.text: And in any case... in your absence, Gwyneth and the guards handled the crisis admirably. The matter is resolved.
say:6:1710666005:1.source_cn: 况且……即便你不在，格温妮丝队长和其他守备军也应对得非...

say:7:1710666006:1.text: Your generosity is appreciated, Your Highness. But as royal guards, protecting you is our duty.
say:7:1710666006:1.source_cn: 殿下宽宏大量。不过，身为皇家守备军，护卫殿下安危本就是...

say:8:1710666007:1.text: Slaying that creature was simply Gwyneth doing her job. It hardly warrants such an extraordinary promotion.
say:8:1710666007:1.source_cn: 今日格温妮丝队长击杀怪物，不过是履行了职责而已，实在称...

say:9:1710666008:1.text: Promoting a soldier simply for performing their duty sets a poor precedent. I must ask you to reconsider.
say:9:1710666008:1.source_cn: 若是因为做了分内之事，就获得先锋官这样破格的提拔，恐怕...

say:11:1710666009:0.text: Come now, Hendrik! Don't be so strict!
say:11:1710666009:0.source_cn: 哎呀，亨德里克司令，您这就太严苛了！

say:13:1710666010:0.text: Exactly! The girl saved our lives!
say:13:1710666010:0.source_cn: 就是就是！格温妮丝小姐今日可是救了我们所有人的命！

say:14:1710666011:1.text: ... I speak to uphold discipline. This promotion is excessive—
say:14:1710666011:1.source_cn: ……属下是为了维护军纪，此事确实不值得如此擢升——

say:17:1710666013:1.text: Is nothing I do ever good enough for you?!
say:17:1710666013:1.source_cn: 在您眼里，无论我做什么，都只是理所应当吗？！

say:18:1710666014:1.text: You always do this... You never once gave me credit.
say:18:1710666014:1.source_cn: 您总是这样，永远不肯承认我的价值……

say:19:1710666015:1.text: Your Highness, I accept! If my own father doubts me, then I'll go to Ashvale County and earn this honor myself!
say:19:1710666015:1.source_cn: 奥利安殿下，格温妮丝领命！既然父亲认为我不够格，那我就...

say:22:1710666017:1.text: Enough. Hendrik is strict, but Gwyneth's determination is admirable.
say:22:1710666017:1.source_cn: 好了，好了。亨德里克卿确实治军严谨。不过，格温妮丝队长...

say:23:1710666018:1.text: This appointment shall remain in place for the time being. Hendrik, I do not wish to see you and your daughter at odds.
say:23:1710666018:1.source_cn: 这项任命暂时保留。亨德里克卿，我不希望看到你们父女反目。

say:24:1710666019:1.source_cn: 你们回去好好商议一番，但我相信——

say:25:1710666020:1.text: But I trust that you would never stand in the way of a promising officer's future, right?
say:25:1710666020:1.source_cn: 作为司令，你一定不会阻拦年轻人的历练和前程，对吧？

say:26:1710666021:1.text: ... I will heed your advice, Your Highness.

say:27:1710666022:1.text: Good. This matter is closed. Honored guests, please rest here. We will return to the palace together shortly.
say:27:1710666022:1.source_cn: 好了，此事到此为止。各位贵宾请先在营地稍作休息，稍后随...

say:29:1710666023:1.text: The crowd begins to drift apart. Nobles move toward the tents in small groups, still whispering about the drama.
say:29:1710666023:1.source_cn: 人群逐渐散去，贵族们三三两两地进入帐篷休息，口中还议论...

say:30:1710666024:1.text: You notice that in trying to protect his daughter, Hendrik has only pushed his ambitious daughter further away—exactly as the Prince intended.
say:30:1710666024:1.source_cn: 你站在人群边缘，意识到亨德里克为了保护女儿，结果反而中...
say:30:1710666024:1.male: You notice that in trying to protect his daughter, Hendrik has only pushed his ambitious daughter further away—exactly as the Prince intended.
say:30:1710666024:1.female: You notice that in trying to protect his daughter, Hendrik has only pushed his ambitious daughter further away—exactly as the Prince intended.
